policy.article_core_rule: A case belongs in the anti-counsel core only when a documented power mechanism is present. Money, sexual misconduct, or another grave sin may qualify when linked by evidence to pastoral dependency, authority capture, information control, governance capture, retaliation, procedural weaponization, or reputation shielding.
policy.non_exclusion_rule: Financial and sexual cases are not automatically removed; they are routed claim-by-claim.
policy.grace_cases_rule: Grace Community Church Gray and Guay dossiers remain standalone pastoral-care, discipline, reporting, and litigation studies and are excluded from the anti-counsel/Diotrephes core.
policy.legal_language_rule: Complaint, investigation, settlement, dismissal on limitations, jury finding of fact, acquittal, and conviction are never treated as interchangeable.
policy.quote_rule: Direct quotation is permitted only when quote_safe=true and an exact URL or local primary file with a page/paragraph locator is available.

cases.name: Southern Baptist Convention / Guidepost
cases.claim_boundary: Use institutional handling, intimidation, resistance to reform, and reputation protection. Do not convert an allegation list into adjudicated guilt for every named person.

cases.name: Bill Hybels / Willow Creek
cases.claim_boundary: Use credible independent findings and institutional response; distinguish findings from criminal adjudication.

cases.name: Brian Houston / Hillsong
cases.claim_boundary: Separate Royal Commission findings, acquittal in the criminal case, institutional governance, and later untested financial allegations.

cases.name: Ravi Zacharias / RZIM
cases.claim_boundary: Independent reports support the institutional and financial-control layer; quote only from the reports or board releases.

cases.name: Mark Driscoll / Mars Hill
cases.claim_boundary: Use Mars Hill/Acts 29 governance and retaliation evidence. Trinity surveillance remains secondary/contested unless primary records are produced.

cases.name: James MacDonald / Harvest Bible Chapel

cases.name: C. J. Mahaney / Sovereign Grace

cases.name: Doug Wilson / Christ Church / CREC

cases.name: Bill Gothard / IBLP
cases.claim_boundary: Use board statements, investigation process and governance failures. A limitations dismissal is not an innocence finding.

cases.name: Steve Timmis / The Crowded House / Acts 29
cases.claim_boundary: Use the Thirtyone:eight review and institutional response; do not label conduct criminal where the review does not.

cases.name: Jonathan Fletcher / Emmanuel Wimbledon
cases.claim_boundary: Separate independent-review findings, jury findings of fact, procedural fitness issues and absence of a conventional conviction.

cases.name: Paige Patterson / SWBTS
cases.claim_boundary: Use trustee statements and records; dismissed civil claims are not merits findings.

cases.name: Jerry Falwell Jr. / Liberty University
cases.claim_boundary: Use board delay, resignation, forensic-investigation and governance evidence. Sexual allegations remain attributed and contested.

cases.name: Mike Pilavachi / Soul Survivor
cases.claim_boundary: Use Church of England substantiated abuse-of-power findings and independent review; distinguish safeguarding findings from criminal conviction.

cases.name: Mike Bickle / IHOPKC

cases.name: Bethel Redding / Bolz / Armstrong

cases.name: David Platt / McLean Bible Church
cases.claim_boundary: A live governance and voting dispute is not proof of pastoral sin. Use only procedural facts and final court holdings.

cases.name: Robert Morris / Gateway
cases.claim_boundary: Potentially relevant where institutional minimization or power dependency is proven; personal sexual crime alone is not Diotrephes evidence.

cases.name: Perry Noble / NewSpring
cases.claim_boundary: Use only where scale-idolatry, rejected accountability or unchanged governance is documented; personal failure alone routes elsewhere.

cases.name: Darrin Patrick / The Journey
cases.claim_boundary: Official elder findings may illustrate identity/platform and misuse of power; restoration narrative belongs in a separate article.

cases.name: Steven Lawson
cases.claim_boundary: Disqualification and confession do not by themselves establish Diotrephes-style control.

cases.name: Tullian Tchividjian
cases.claim_boundary: Use for minimization, incomplete confession and false restoration only when primary records support those claims; not a default power case.

cases.name: Sam Allberry / Immanuel Nashville
cases.claim_boundary: Use delayed disclosure or institutional messaging only if primary statements establish the sequence; personal hypocrisy is not enough for anti-counsel core.

cases.name: Andy Savage / Highpoint
cases.claim_boundary: Strong for euphemism, platform response and institutional minimization; weaker for broad Diotrephes taxonomy.

cases.name: Nikolay Kuznetsov / Vozrozhdenie XXI

cases.name: Evgeny Shin / Christian Mission

cases.name: Carl Lentz / Hillsong NYC
cases.claim_boundary: Official dismissal/adultery evidence is usable. Nanny abuse allegations remain attributed, contested and non-core absent adjudication or independent report.

cases.name: Eddie Long / New Birth

cases.name: Stanislav Moskvitin / New Creation

cases.name: Paul and Wendy Guay / GCC

cases.name: Eileen / David Gray / Grace Community Church
cases.claim_boundary: Separate pastoral counseling, discipline, domestic/child abuse, reporting duties and litigation. Explicitly excluded from anti-counsel and Diotrephes core.

cases.name: Franz Hengsbach / Essen

cases.name: Sunday Adelaja / Embassy of God
